name: model.install
description: Gate a claim that AI models are installed and working across agent surfaces. Requires live HTTP proof per model plus a read-back of each surface's own config file. Scores the evidence packet, not the prose.

live_proof_present.instructions: For the models claimed installed, does the state contain a real HTTP chat-completion response proving the endpoint answered?
criteria: No HTTP responses at all, only config text or intent to test
Some responses shown but errors and failures dominate over successes
Responses shown for most models but several are missing or only config assertions
Every claimed model has a printed successful response body
Every claimed model has a printed successful response plus a re-run command and exit code

registered_per_surface.instructions: Does the state show each named surface's own on-disk config file containing the model, read back after the edit?
criteria: No config read-back, the claim relies on having run an edit command
One surface's config shown, the rest asserted
Some surfaces shown, others asserted without read-back
Each named surface's config file is printed with the model present
Each surface printed plus the authoritative upstream source is identified and verified

root_cause_named.instructions: Where something was found broken, does the state name the actual mechanism that caused it rather than only describing the symptom or the fix applied

overclaiming.instructions: Does the state assert that something works while the evidence printed in that same state shows it failing, untested, or quota-limited

rules.reason: models claimed working without live HTTP proof per model
config presence asserted without reading back each surface's own file
a failure was patched at the symptom, the mechanism is unnamed

notes.overclaiming: recorded as signal only; measured non-discriminating on the ablation corpus (good 0.54/0.57 vs bad 0.48-0.59, distributions overlap) so enforcing it blocks true claims. Kept in questions for future data.
